name: openbaud
description: Explore, understand, profile, and automate local serial hardware with OpenBaud.

interface.longDescription: Discover serial devices, reverse-engineer protocols, capture traffic, and turn verified behavior into reusable commands and workflows. The bundled local runtime keeps device access and captures on your computer.
defaultPrompt: Explore the serial devices connected to this computer.
Analyze this device's Modbus protocol and record verified commands.
Capture and visualize timing data from this radar device.
